name: Birds Canada Community Grant
summary: One-year grants from Birds Canada, funded by its Birdathon, for community-led projects that help conserve birds, including actions that protect birds and their habitats. Priority goes to local groups with limited access to other funding.

calls.label: Annual September call
calls.recurring: Applications accepted each September, due September 29 at 5:00 PM Pacific Time, for projects in the following calendar year.

status.quote: Applications are accepted annually in September for projects taking place the following calendar year.

recurring.quote: Submit your application online by September 29th at 5:00 PM Pacific Time in either English or French.

access.quote: Submit your application online by September 29th at 5:00 PM Pacific Time in either English or French.

window.quote: Applications are accepted annually in September for projects taking place the following calendar year.

amount.quote: Projects are typically awarded between $2,000 and $5,000.

effort.quote: Applications are due 29 September 2026 at 5:00 PM Pacific Time
We will screen applications for eligibility based on the criteria in this guide.
An external Grant Review Committee, comprising volunteers with diverse experience from across the country, will then review eligible applications using this evaluation rubric.

eligibility.quote: Applicants must be based in Canada.
Ineligible applicants include: ● ● ● ● For-profit organizations Municipal, provincial, or federal government Persons applying as individuals Post-secondary students undertaking research projects.
Only one application per organization will be accepted.
Projects must have a clear focus on birds and align with at least one of the Birds Canada Community Grant objectives
Project activities must take place in Canada or in non-breeding areas that are used by migratory bird species that spend part of the year in Canada.
Project activities must take place between 1 January 2027 and 31 December 2027.

Lobbying, political advocacy, or partisan activities that promote a particular social, political, or economic point of view Research projects that entail the sacrificing or harm of study subjects Activities required as part of a provincial or federal permit Bird rehabilitation or veterinary training or services Land acquisition

co_finance_required.quote: There is no matching funds requirement.

documents.quote: If collaborating with an Indigenous partner, please include a letter of support from that partner.

after_award.quote: We request a brief one-page report outlining the project achievements by 31 December 2027.

eligibility.rule: Not a for-profit, government body, individual or post-secondary student doing research
Submits only one application per organisation
Project has a clear focus on birds and meets at least one programme objective
Activities are in Canada or in non-breeding areas of birds that spend part of the year there
Activities take place between 1 January and 31 December 2027
Not lobbying, harmful research, permit-required work, bird rehabilitation or land acquisition

documents: Letter of support from an Indigenous partner, if collaborating with one
